note: Practical ground guide for the Premier League to the National League North/South, 2026/27. Facts from Wikipedia (facts only, no prose), Wikidata, OpenStreetMap and official club/league/supporters' sites; fan tips in our own words. Every item carries its source. Method: qa/research/ground-guide-en.md.
